text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
I look forward to another fine year working alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And so...
not to waste time, but are those preparations ready?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I see. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Now then, forward—

Kneeling down, I pick up the remote and launch the streaming service...
bringing up the list of programs I was looking for.

Yes, 'the preparations in question' were simply getting ready
to watch the New Year's special TV broadcasts—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I heard from a classmate.
During the New Year holidays, there exist things known as 'special programs' that air but once a year.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A rarity truly akin to the Queen of the Night.
I, too, would dearly love to lay eyes upon it, but—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: There is a slight problem.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Over the New Year holidays this year,
I am kept relentlessly busy with banquets,
soirees, and formal greetings.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Presumably, there is no time for that.
Which is why... I would like to borrow your counsel.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Catch-up streaming on a video service, is it?
To think such a convenient thing existed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Well, time is precious.
What would you recommend for the opening move?
choice_data_list: 一流を見極めるバラエティ番組

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see, manzai... is it? A sophisticated performing art
said to cultivate laughter through exquisite repartee.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: By all means, I shall take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Comedian A
text_block_list.text:
“Time for a classic relatable moment!
Umamusume things: breaking away early, then closing from behind!”

text_block_list.name: Comedian B
text_block_list.text:
“That ain't an everyday thing! Not even close!
That’s Silence Suzuka right there!
Nobody else can pull that off!”

text_block_list.name: Comedian B
text_block_list.text:
“‘Everyday thing’ means stuff that happens all the time!
Give me a real one!”

text_block_list.name: Comedian A
text_block_list.text:
“Relatable Umamusume moment!
Winning a graded stakes race by a massive margin!”

text_block_list.name: Comedian B
text_block_list.text:
"'No way in hell is that normal! It ain't normal at all!
Silence Suzuka did it again! No normal runner could pull that off!
A ten-length lead is straight-up impossible!'"

text_block_list.name: Comedian A
text_block_list.text:
“Relatable Umamusume moment!
Refusing to yield the view from the front!”

text_block_list.name: Comedian B
text_block_list.text:
“That’s just Silence Suzuka!
What’s the deal?! Are you just a fan?!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: What is... this? Exactly which aspect is posited to evoke laughter?

In any case, Rose Kingdom continued to enjoy
the manzai comedy routine with keen interest.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A lavish year-end music broadcast, is it?
Truth be told, I am not well-versed in the music of the common folk.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It should also serve as a fine opportunity
to gain insight into what is currently in fashion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—A magnificent dance.
Their movements are in complete unison, right down to their fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Just how much discipline must one undergo
to reach such heights...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A succession of unfamiliar terms... Neologisms, perhaps?
Do they reflect the youth culture of the common public?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Golden confetti, is it...
The entire stage is quite elegant.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The performers' outfits are utterly gorgeous.
Truly befitting a music festival that brings the year to a close.

Rose Kingdom continued to enjoy the music program
with keen interest long after that.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A variety show where one distinguishes top-tier luxury items from counterfeits.
I see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
An educational program that tests one's aesthetic eye, is it?
Intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text: “Can you distinguish the melody of a first-class violin?”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: いかがいたしましたか？

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No—is it not ②?
Why is everyone choosing ①...?
Of course, it is by no means a poor tone, but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Could that manner of melody be the current trend these days, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text: "The correct answer was number two!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh—I see.
This is quite delightful, I must admit.

Rose Kingdom continued to enjoy the variety show
with curious fascination long after that.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once again, thank you.
I was able to learn much more about common culture.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Above all, I feel I have restored my vigor for the year ahead.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Let us dedicate our utmost efforts together again this year.
And thus, a new year began.
